title: Fourier norm of a reindexed restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $h$ be a sign-valued function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. The Fourier one-norm of the restriction of $h$, viewed as a real-valued function on a cube indexed by $J$, equals the sum of the absolute values of its Fourier coefficients indexed by subsets of $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates
